---
title: "Alignment and quality control: Twi, Kr and Stat92E ChIP-seq"
author: "Yermek Aiten"
output: html_document
---

**Twist**: ENCSR119OUI — 2 reps (ENCFF918UHG, ENCFF271FJU) + 1 control (ENCFF082BHL). SE50nt. Standard 2-rep pipeline like TRH.

**Krüppel**: ENCSR156QJC — 2 reps (ENCFF267FIR, ENCFF635AOG) + 1 control (ENCFF943DWF). SE50nt. Standard 2-rep pipeline.

**STAT92E**: three separate experiments:
- ENCSR240ADR — 2 reps (ENCFF047YGA, ENCFF274EPE) + control (ENCFF610AIH). SE50nt. Experiment A.
- ENCSR290OJD — 2 reps (ENCFF677DJI, ENCFF056WPO) + control (ENCFF331FON). SE50nt. Experiment A2.
- ENCSR494UZY — 2 reps (ENCFF052DLA, ENCFF199LTY) + control (ENCFF799QGS). SE50nt. Experiment B.

Each dataset is processed independently. All are SE50nt, so MACS3 is run with `--nomodel --extsize` from SPP, as for Trh. Krüppel and the three Stat92E datasets were excluded from the control analysis on the quality-control grounds given in the text (RSC for Krüppel; replicate reproducibility for Stat92E).

```{bash alignment-twi, include=TRUE, eval=FALSE}
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ============================================================
# STAGE 1, ALIGNMENT: TWIST (SE50nt)
# ENCFF918UHG = TWI rep1
# ENCFF271FJU = TWI rep2
# ENCFF082BHL = TWI control
# ============================================================
set -euo pipefail

conda activate phd

bowtie2 -x dm6 \
  -U 01_fastqc/twi/ENCFF918UHG.fastq.gz \
  -S 03_bam/TWI_rep1.sam -p 8

bowtie2 -x dm6 \
  -U 01_fastqc/twi/ENCFF271FJU.fastq.gz \
  -S 03_bam/TWI_rep2.sam -p 8

bowtie2 -x dm6 \
  -U 01_fastqc/twi/ENCFF082BHL.fastq.gz \
  -S 03_bam/TWI_control.sam -p 8

for SAMPLE in TWI_rep1 TWI_rep2 TWI_control
do
  samtools view -bS 03_bam/${SAMPLE}.sam \
    | samtools sort -o 03_bam/${SAMPLE}.bam
  rm 03_bam/${SAMPLE}.sam
  echo "${SAMPLE} aligned and sorted"
done
```

```{bash alignment-stat92e, include=TRUE, eval=FALSE}
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ============================================================
# STAGE 1, alignment: STAT92E (SE50nt)
# Experiment A ENCSR240ADR: ENCFF047YGA rep1, ENCFF274EPE rep2, ENCFF610AIH control
# Experiment A2 ENCSR290OJD: ENCFF677DJI rep1, ENCFF056WPO rep2, ENCFF331FON control
# Experiment B ENCSR494UZY: ENCFF052
set -euo pipefail

conda activate phd

# --- Experiment A ---
bowtie2 -x dm6 \
  -U 01_fastqc/stat92e/ENCFF047YGA.fastq.gz \
  -S 03_bam/STAT92E_A_rep1.sam -p 8

bowtie2 -x dm6 \
  -U 01_fastqc/stat92e/ENCFF274EPE.fastq.gz \
  -S 03_bam/STAT92E_A_rep2.sam -p 8

bowtie2 -x dm6 \
  -U 01_fastqc/stat92e/ENCFF610AIH.fastq.gz \
  -S 03_bam/STAT92E_A_control.sam -p 8

# --- Experiment A2 ---
bowtie2 -x dm6 \
  -U 01_fastqc/stat92e/ENCFF677DJI.fastq.gz \
  -S 03_bam/STAT92E_A2_rep1.sam -p 8

bowtie2 -x dm6 \
  -U 01_fastqc/stat92e/ENCFF056WPO.fastq.gz \
  -S 03_bam/STAT92E_A2_rep2.sam -p 8

bowtie2 -x dm6 \
  -U 01_fastqc/stat92e/ENCFF331FON.fastq.gz \
  -S 03_bam/STAT92E_A2_control.sam -p 8

# --- Experiment B ---
bowtie2 -x dm6 \
  -U 01_fastqc/stat92e/ENCFF052DLA.fastq.gz \
  -S 03_bam/STAT92E_B_rep1.sam -p 8

bowtie2 -x dm6 \
  -U 01_fastqc/stat92e/ENCFF199LTY.fastq.gz \
  -S 03_bam/STAT92E_B_rep2.sam -p 8

bowtie2 -x dm6 \
  -U 01_fastqc/stat92e/ENCFF799QGS.fastq.gz \
  -S 03_bam/STAT92E_B_control.sam -p 8

              #STAT92E_A_rep1 STAT92E_A_rep2 STAT92E_A_control \
              #STAT92E_B_rep1 STAT92E_B_rep2 STAT92E_B_control
for SAMPLE in STAT92E_A2_rep1 STAT92E_A2_rep2 STAT92E_A2_control 
do
  samtools view -bS 03_bam/${SAMPLE}.sam \
    | samtools sort -o 03_bam/${SAMPLE}.bam
  rm 03_bam/${SAMPLE}.sam
  echo "${SAMPLE} aligned and sorted"
done
```

```{bash readgroups-all, include=TRUE, eval=FALSE}
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ============================================================
# STAGE 2, ADD READ GROUPS: ALL FACTORS
# ============================================================
set -euo pipefail

add_rg() {
  local SAMPLE=$1
  local RGID=$2
  picard -Djava.io.tmpdir=$PROJECT_DIR/tmp \
    AddOrReplaceReadGroups \
    I=03_bam/${SAMPLE}.bam \
    O=03_bam/${SAMPLE}.RG.bam \
    RGID=${RGID} RGLB=lib1 RGPL=ILLUMINA RGPU=unit1 RGSM=${RGID}
  echo "${SAMPLE} read groups added"
}

# Twist
add_rg TWI_rep1    TWI_rep1
add_rg TWI_rep2    TWI_rep2
add_rg TWI_control TWI_ctrl

# Krüppel
add_rg KR_rep1    KR_rep1
add_rg KR_rep2    KR_rep2
add_rg KR_control KR_ctrl

# STAT92E experiment A
add_rg STAT92E_A_rep1    STAT92E_A_rep1
add_rg STAT92E_A_rep2    STAT92E_A_rep2
add_rg STAT92E_A_control STAT92E_A_ctrl

# STAT92E experiment A2
add_rg STAT92E_A2_rep1    STAT92E_A2_rep1
add_rg STAT92E_A2_rep2    STAT92E_A2_rep2
add_rg STAT92E_A2_control STAT92E_A2_ctrl

# STAT92E experiment B
add_rg STAT92E_B_rep1    STAT92E_B_rep1
add_rg STAT92E_B_rep2    STAT92E_B_rep2
add_rg STAT92E_B_control STAT92E_B_ctrl
```

```{bash sort-after-rg, include=TRUE, eval=FALSE}
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ============================================================
# STAGE 3, SORT AFTER READ GROUPS: ALL FACTORS
# ============================================================
set -euo pipefail

for SAMPLE in \
  TWI_rep1 TWI_rep2 TWI_control \
  KR_rep1 KR_rep2 KR_control \
  STAT92E_A_rep1 STAT92E_A_rep2 STAT92E_A_control \
  STAT92E_B_rep1 STAT92E_B_rep2 STAT92E_B_control \
  STAT92E_A2_rep1 STAT92E_A2_rep2 STAT92E_A2_control
do
  samtools sort -@ 8 \
    -o 03_bam/${SAMPLE}.RG.sorted.bam \
    03_bam/${SAMPLE}.RG.bam
  echo "${SAMPLE} sorted after RG"
done
```

```{bash markdup-all, include=TRUE, eval=FALSE}
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ============================================================
# STAGE 4, MARK AND REMOVE DUPLICATES: ALL FACTORS
# ============================================================
set -euo pipefail

for SAMPLE in \
  TWI_rep1 TWI_rep2 TWI_control \
  KR_rep1 KR_rep2 KR_control \
  STAT92E_A_rep1 STAT92E_A_rep2 STAT92E_A_control \
  STAT92E_B_rep1 STAT92E_B_rep2 STAT92E_B_control \
  STAT92E_A2_rep1 STAT92E_A2_rep2 STAT92E_A2_control
do
  picard -Djava.io.tmpdir=$PROJECT_DIR/tmp \
    MarkDuplicates \
    I=03_bam/${SAMPLE}.RG.sorted.bam \
    O=03_bam/${SAMPLE}.rmdup.bam \
    M=04_qc/${SAMPLE}.dup_metrics.txt \
    REMOVE_DUPLICATES=true \
    ASSUME_SORTED=true
  echo "${SAMPLE} duplicates removed"
done
```

```{bash filter-all, include=TRUE, eval=FALSE}
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ============================================================
# STAGE 5, FILTER BAM: ALL FACTORS (SE flags: no -f 2)
# -q 30  : MAPQ >= 30
# -F 1804: exclude unmapped, not primary, duplicate, supplementary
# ============================================================
set -euo pipefail

for SAMPLE in \
  TWI_rep1 TWI_rep2 TWI_control \
  KR_rep1 KR_rep2 KR_control \
  STAT92E_A_rep1 STAT92E_A_rep2 STAT92E_A_control \
  STAT92E_B_rep1 STAT92E_B_rep2 STAT92E_B_control \
  STAT92E_A2_rep1 STAT92E_A2_rep2 STAT92E_A2_control
do
  samtools view -b \
    -q 30 \
    -F 1804 \
    03_bam/${SAMPLE}.rmdup.bam \
    > 03_bam/${SAMPLE}.filtered.bam

  samtools index 03_bam/${SAMPLE}.filtered.bam
  echo "${SAMPLE} filtered"
done
```

```{bash blacklist-all, include=TRUE, eval=FALSE}
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ============================================================
# STAGE 6, BLACKLIST REMOVAL: ALL FACTORS
# ============================================================
set -euo pipefail

for SAMPLE in \
  TWI_rep1 TWI_rep2 TWI_control \
  KR_rep1 KR_rep2 KR_control \
  STAT92E_A_rep1 STAT92E_A_rep2 STAT92E_A_control \
  STAT92E_B_rep1 STAT92E_B_rep2 STAT92E_B_control \
  STAT92E_A2_rep1 STAT92E_A2_rep2 STAT92E_A2_control
do
  bedtools intersect -v \
    -a 03_bam/${SAMPLE}.filtered.bam \
    -b dm6-blacklist.v2.bed \
    > 07_blacklist/${SAMPLE}.clean.bam

  samtools index 07_blacklist/${SAMPLE}.clean.bam
  echo "${SAMPLE} blacklist removed"
done
```

```{bash spp-all, include=TRUE, eval=FALSE}
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ============================================================
# STAGE 8, SPP FRAGMENT SIZE ESTIMATION: ALL FACTORS (SE only)
# Used to derive --extsize for MACS3 --nomodel
# Run on ChIP samples only, not controls
# ============================================================
set -euo pipefail

for SAMPLE in \
  TWI_rep1 TWI_rep2 TWI_control \
  KR_rep1 KR_rep2 KR_control \
  STAT92E_A_rep1 STAT92E_A_rep2 STAT92E_A_control \
  STAT92E_B_rep1 STAT92E_B_rep2 STAT92E_B_control \
  STAT92E_A2_rep1 STAT92E_A2_rep2 STAT92E_A2_control
do
  run_spp.R \
    -c=07_blacklist/${SAMPLE}.clean.bam \
    -s=-100:5:600 \
    -out=04_qc/${SAMPLE}_spp.clean.txt
  echo "${SAMPLE} SPP done"
done

echo ""
echo "=== SPP RESULTS SUMMARY ==="
echo "Factor | Sample | Fragment_est | NSC | RSC | Tag"
for SAMPLE in \
  TWI_rep1 TWI_rep2 TWI_control \
  KR_rep1 KR_rep2 KR_control \
  STAT92E_A_rep1 STAT92E_A_rep2 STAT92E_A_control \
  STAT92E_B_rep1 STAT92E_B_rep2 STAT92E_B_control \
  STAT92E_A2_rep1 STAT92E_A2_rep2 STAT92E_A2_control
do
  FRAG=$(grep -oP 'Top 3 estimates.*?\K[0-9]+' \
    04_qc/${SAMPLE}_spp.clean.txt | head -1)
  NSC=$(grep -oP 'NSC\) [0-9.]+' \
    04_qc/${SAMPLE}_spp.clean.txt | grep -oP '[0-9.]+')
  RSC=$(grep -oP 'RSC\) [0-9.]+' \
    04_qc/${SAMPLE}_spp.clean.txt | grep -oP '[0-9.]+')
  TAG=$(grep -oP 'Quality Tag [0-9-]+' \
    04_qc/${SAMPLE}_spp.clean.txt | grep -oP '[0-9-]+')
  echo "${SAMPLE} | ${FRAG} | ${NSC} | ${RSC} | ${TAG}"
done

# EXTSIZE per factor is set from the SPP output:
# TWI_EXTSIZE = mean(TWI_rep1_fragment, TWI_rep2_fragment)
# KR_EXTSIZE  = mean(KR_rep1_fragment, KR_rep2_fragment)
# STAT92E_A_EXTSIZE = mean(STAT92E_A_rep1_fragment, STAT92E_A_rep2_fragment)
# STAT92E_B_EXTSIZE = mean(STAT92E_B_rep1_fragment, STAT92E_B_rep2_fragment)
# Values are inserted below based on the SPP output
```

```{bash fingerprint-correlation, include=TRUE, eval=FALSE}
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ============================================================
# STAGE 9, FINGERPRINT AND REPLICATE CORRELATION: ALL FACTORS
# Run fingerprint per factor group; correlation per ChIP replicate group only
# ============================================================
set -euo pipefail

# --- Twist fingerprint ---
plotFingerprint \
  -b 07_blacklist/TWI_rep1.clean.bam \
     07_blacklist/TWI_rep2.clean.bam \
     07_blacklist/TWI_control.clean.bam \
  --plotFile 04_qc/fingerprint/TWI_fingerprint.png \
  --outRawCounts 04_qc/fingerprint/TWI_fingerprint.tab \
  --numberOfSamples 500000 \
  --extendReads 220 \
  -p 8

# --- Krüppel fingerprint ---
plotFingerprint \
  -b 07_blacklist/KR_rep1.clean.bam \
     07_blacklist/KR_rep2.clean.bam \
     07_blacklist/KR_control.clean.bam \
  --plotFile 04_qc/fingerprint/KR_fingerprint.png \
  --outRawCounts 04_qc/fingerprint/KR_fingerprint.tab \
  --numberOfSamples 500000 \
  --extendReads 110 \
  -p 8

# --- STAT92E experiment A fingerprint ---
plotFingerprint \
  -b 07_blacklist/STAT92E_A_rep1.clean.bam \
     07_blacklist/STAT92E_A_rep2.clean.bam \
     07_blacklist/STAT92E_A_control.clean.bam \
  --plotFile 04_qc/fingerprint/STAT92E_A_fingerprint.png \
  --outRawCounts 04_qc/fingerprint/STAT92E_A_fingerprint.tab \
  --numberOfSamples 500000 \
  --extendReads 75 \
  -p 8

plotFingerprint \
  -b 07_blacklist/STAT92E_A2_rep1.clean.bam \
     07_blacklist/STAT92E_A2_rep2.clean.bam \
     07_blacklist/STAT92E_A2_control.clean.bam \
  --plotFile 04_qc/fingerprint/STAT92E_A2_fingerprint.png \
  --outRawCounts 04_qc/fingerprint/STAT92E_A2_fingerprint.tab \
  --numberOfSamples 500000 \
  --extendReads 75 \
  -p 8
  
# --- STAT92E experiment B fingerprint ---
plotFingerprint \
  -b 07_blacklist/STAT92E_B_rep1.clean.bam \
     07_blacklist/STAT92E_B_rep2.clean.bam \
     07_blacklist/STAT92E_B_control.clean.bam \
  --plotFile 04_qc/fingerprint/STAT92E_B_fingerprint.png \
  --outRawCounts 04_qc/fingerprint/STAT92E_B_fingerprint.tab \
  --numberOfSamples 500000 \
  --extendReads 80 \
  -p 8

# --- Spearman correlation per factor ---
for FACTOR in TWI KR
do
  multiBamSummary bins \
    -b 07_blacklist/${FACTOR}_rep1.clean.bam \
       07_blacklist/${FACTOR}_rep2.clean.bam \
    --labels ${FACTOR}_rep1 ${FACTOR}_rep2 \
    -o 08_qc/${FACTOR}.npz \
    -p 8

  plotCorrelation \
    -in 08_qc/${FACTOR}.npz \
    --corMethod spearman \
    --skipZeros \
    --whatToPlot heatmap \
    --plotFile 08_qc/${FACTOR}_spearman_heatmap.pdf \
    --outFileCorMatrix 08_qc/${FACTOR}_spearman_matrix.txt
done

# STAT92E: correlate within each experiment separately
# Do not correlate across experiments A and B
for EXP in A A2 B
do
  multiBamSummary bins \
    -b 07_blacklist/STAT92E_${EXP}_rep1.clean.bam \
       07_blacklist/STAT92E_${EXP}_rep2.clean.bam \
    --labels STAT92E_${EXP}_rep1 STAT92E_${EXP}_rep2 \
    -o 08_qc/STAT92E_${EXP}.npz \
    -p 8

  plotCorrelation \
    -in 08_qc/STAT92E_${EXP}.npz \
    --corMethod spearman \
    --skipZeros \
    --whatToPlot heatmap \
    --plotFile 08_qc/STAT92E_${EXP}_spearman_heatmap.pdf \
    --outFileCorMatrix 08_qc/STAT92E_${EXP}_spearman_matrix.txt
done
```
